description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Higher-order Turbulence and its Effects on Structural Loads and Response: A Study on Experimental Equivalence is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jennifer Bridge, University of Florida (ufl.edu). This research investigates differing higher-order turbulence for second-order equivalent wind fields and its effects on peak wind pressures on low-rise structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5fe4-8750. Keywords: University of Florida, Boundary layer wind tunnel, Wind engineering, Statistical equivalence, Higher-order turbulence, REU. Published 2022-08-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
